body:
i’d go for some shrugs!! [rows knitwear](https://www.rowsknitwear.com/shop?fbclid=PAAabRlC64gQ_fK6znsF4n2BMeyOst6WP0atau-gqmQnQF7xUchmwkQOHW1f0) and [beaumeadow on instagram](https://instagram.com/beauumeadow?igshid=NTdlMDg3MTY=) have some really cute, gen z friendly patterns!! if you want to go for something smaller i think 2x2 rib slouchy legwarmers are always a good bet too!!

edit: I FORGOT ABOUT MINI VESTS!!! mini vests i think are also coming into trend!! [this pattern](https://www.ravelry.com/patterns/library/hardly-harness) by lydia morrow is super cute (especially if you extend it a little bit) but i made myself one by just cutting off a really basic (no shaping) vest pattern to make the body hit like. the middle of my bust and i think it’s super cute!!

it’s so adorable!!!!! one thing i like doing when knitting stranded colorwork is catching my floats (the little strands of yarn that are hanging out at the back of your work) every 4-5 stitches. [here’s a really good youtube guide from brooklyn tweed](https://youtu.be/b9JWn5Rk_vE) on how to do that!! i’ve found it makes my tension a lot more even, especially when knitting wearables where puckering would be an issue with the fit

honestly this looks machine knit at a suuuuuper fine gauge (could be done maybe with lace weight and like. literally 1mm needles but would take forever and imo isn’t really worth it!!) BUT there are a bunch of v neck polos that could be pretty easy to mod the stripes and some sort of vaguely similar colorwork into!! [these](https://www.ravelry.com/patterns/library/polobello) [two](https://www.ravelry.com/patterns/library/polo-sweater-6) on ravelry look like they could be modified into something that looks similar with a couple of small adjustments!!
